disjointRanges.title: Disjoint ranges
disjointRanges.description: Try 5 or 25 (valid), then 15 (invalid). One input accepts either range.

exclusiveMultiples.title: Exclusive multiples
exclusiveMultiples.description: Try 6 or 10 (valid). 15 matches both branches and is invalid.

invalidMultiple.title: Initially invalid multiple
invalidMultiple.description: The initial 15 is retained and reported as invalid. Change it to 6 or 10.

combinedBounds.title: Combined validation bounds
combinedBounds.description: Enter an integer from 2 to 10. Both constraints validate the same value.

outerBounds.title: Enclosing bounds with alternatives
outerBounds.description: The enclosing 0–100 bounds remain applicable. Values 11–19 still fail the alternatives.

inferredText.title: Inferred string editor
inferredText.description: Start with A or enter at least five characters. Try AB (valid), xy (invalid), or hello (valid).
